title: 機械設計演習(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Machine Design Project
keywords: JIS standards and mechanical drawings 2.Strength and reliability design 3.Manufacturing method and accuracy/tolerance 4.3-axis 2-stage helical reducer 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Students will learn about machine design and manufacturing processes and create design plans and drawings that meet the required specifications. In this course, students will create a design for strength and reliability that follows the engineering drawing, a manufacturing design that considers the manufacturing method and cost, and a draft that represents the mechanical mechanism and overall configuration.
advice: The main mechanism studied in this course is a three-axis two-stage helical gear reducer, and we will use it to acquire the ability to systematically design machines through comprehensive exercises on design accuracy, strength, and reliability of design. Basically, lectures and exercises are held weekly. However, the design and drafting of assigned tasks will not be completed in the practice time during the lecture, so preparation and review as homework will be necessary. In addition, students will use the basics of Solid Edge that were taught in “Mechanical Drawing I” and “Mechanical Drawing II” that they attended before taking this course. It is assumed that you have mastered the operating and reference methods of the JIS drawing textbook, so please check this material carefully before taking this course. The topics covered in this course are as follows: (1) Mechanical design and design process improvement; (2) Design problems, design concepts, and basic design; (3) Design problem strength, reliability of design, and detailed design; (4) Mechanical design problem drawing; (5 ) Inspection of mechanical design problem drawings; and (6) Self-inspection and third-party evaluation of mechanical design problems.
books: Textbooks: New JIS Mechanical Drawing (5th edition) , Morikita Publishing Co., Ltd. (in Japanese) Mechanical Drawing -Operation Method using Solid Edge- ,Kanazawa Institute of Technology (in Japanese) Machine Design Project(helical reducer), Helical Reducer Design,Powersha Co., Ltd. (in Japanese) Reference books: Methods of Machine Design, Morikita Publishing Co., Ltd. (in Japanese) Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: This course is intended as a design and drafting course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering in accordance with mechanical principles, Mechanical Drawing I, Mechanical Drawing II, and Mechanical Element Design. Therefore, to participate in this course, the design and CAD drawing abilities acquired in these courses are required. Before attending this course, it is recommended that you review the content acquired in previous courses. Persistent effort is necessary.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the implementation of mechanical design, and use drawings to explain design images.
Be able to carry out design calculations, such as basic design and detailed design of components.
Be able to model a mechanism design and calculate its strength using a computer.
Be able to create machine designs that consider manufacturing methods, according to the machine drafting rules.
Be able to conceive new design solutions by integrating specialized fields of mechanical engineering.
Be able to learn the latest technology from local engineers, and organize and discuss assignments.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand the substance and shape of the design according to the instructions and prepare an easy-to-read assembly drawing by applying it to your own design conditions. (2) Summarize the flow of design calculations in detail using a computer. (3) Understand design modeling and strength calculations according to the instructions. (4) Perform drafting while fully avoiding shapes that cannot be manufactured or are difficult to form. (5) Derive design solutions which added originality according to the instructions. (6) Understand the design and problem-solving techniques presented by local engineers.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the content and shape of the design according to the instructions. (2) Summarize the flow of design calculations with a chart using a computer and perform design calculations according to the issues. (3) Understand design modeling and strength calculations according to the instructions. (4) Perform drafting while avoiding shapes that cannot be manufactured or are difficult to form. (5) Derive design solutions according to the instructions, derive design solutions. (6) Understand the design and problem-solving techniques presented by local engineers.

lessons.content: Guidance: ・ Review the outline of this course. ・ Understand the course objectives, goals, and levels required to achieve them ・ Review design problems and specifications. ・ Understand the learning goals, outlines, and behavioral goals of the course using the distributed learning support plan. In particular, understand which part of the faculty's educational goals this course is responsible for and the specific measure of achievement level. Outline of 3-stage 2-axis helical gear reducer: ・ Review the outline and features of the 3-stage 2-axis helical gear reducer. ・ Attend lecture on the content of the textbook and observe points to be noted. Outline of design and exercise: ・ Review the design outline based on the distributed materials and the textbook.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A Note: In this column, “design” indicates the design of the helical reduction gear, “exercise” indicates the machine design exercise, and “design method” indicates the machine design method. Design: pp. 1-6 Exercise: pp. 1-7
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Make sure that Solid Edge is ready for use. ・ Understand the relationship between the educational goals of the department and this subject. ・ Examine the functional performance of the helical reducer. Review: ・ Reconfirm the content and objectives of this course, reconfirm your design specifications as explained, and start design calculations.

lessons.content: Practice using actual 3-axis 2-stage gear reducer: ・ Understand the main elements, such as fittings, bearings, and drafting angle, through disassembly and assembly of the gear reducer as a product, sketches, and measurements of main dimensions. In addition, understand that each part is made according to JIS standards, and confirm the method used to reference JIS standards.
lessons.operation: Practice Q&A Disassembly and measurement of helical reducer Understand functions and performance through assembly. Design: pp. 56-72 Exercise: pp. 8-9 and 85-100
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Investigate and understand gear reducers. ・ Investigate reducer components. Review: ・ Draft drawings according to basic design policy. ・ Review what you learned in machine element design. ・ Check the design items for each element to understand the causal relationship. ・ Perform design calculations.

lessons.content: Outline of 3-axis 2-stage helical gear reducer: ・ Attend lecture on the content of the textbook and receive instructions on how to proceed with the design calculation and note important points in the design calculation. Explanation of mechanism, layout, and plan: ・ Before proceeding with the design work, review the meaning of each drawing and receive instructions necessary for design calculations. Perform design calculations.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A Exercise Design calculation necessary for basic design Explain mechanism, layout and plan Design: pp. 9-25 Exercise: pp. 9-17
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Understand the process of design work. ・ Check the basic design items. ・ Perform the design calculations. Review: ・ Review the content of the lecture, review the design calculations, and complete the design calculations. ・ Complete the reduction gear design calculation (performance and outline calculation).

lessons.content: Strength and selection of machine element parts (such as keys): ・ Review how to calculate the strength of mechanical elements, such as keys, required for the design and how to select them. Perform design calculations.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A Exercise Explain the detailed design of the entire gear reducer Design: pp. 27-52 Exercise: pp. 18-30
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Investigate the strength calculation method for each component ・ Implement a design calculation document. Review: ・ Deepen your understanding of material strength and mechanical strength. ・ Review the lecture content, review the design calculation sheet, and complete the design calculation sheet and plan.

lessons.content: Review of precautions when creating assembly drawings: ・ Explain the points to be noted when creating assembly drawings (such as corner radii R and corner chamfers C). ・ Describe functional design defects that tend to occur in assembly drawings. Create assembly drawings: ・ Start to create assembly drawings based on the design calculations. In addition, understand that the creation of assembly drawings requires review of design calculation documents and feedback. Submit design calculation sheets and plan drawings.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A Exercise Explain the relationship between design calculations (performance and strength requirements) and drawing requirements for manufacturing Design: pp. 74-78 Exercise: pp. 37-58
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Understand the relationship between design calculation and drawing (drafting rules) ・ Complete the design calculation sheet and plan, and prepare printed materials. Review: ・ Creation of assembly drawing based on mechanism drawing, layout drawing, and plan drawing of design calculations. ・ Check the relationship between requirements based on drafting rules and requirements based on design calculations. ・ Start creating assembly drawings.

lessons.content: Description of assembly drawing checklist: ・ Review the content of the assembly drawing checklist and deepen your recognition of points to be noted. Create assembly drawings. Check the consistency of the design calculation sheet and assembly drawing: ・ Check the design calculation sheet and assembly drawing check points, and participate in free-form discussions of the design solution features and ingenious points. Creation of design calculation sheet and assembly drawing: ・ Completion of design calculation sheet and assembly drawing. (Students can earn bonus points for submission of design calculation sheet and assembly drawing.)
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A Exercise Understand the relationship between design calculation requirements and drawing requirements Review design points for design calculation and drafting drawings Design: pp. 80-116 Exercise: pp. 59-64 and 75-84
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Confirm rules for interfaces between components. ・ Organize the relation between design policy and design solution for each design solution. ・ Create assembly drawings. Review: ・ Consistency check for each component according to the assembly drawing. ・ Organization of design outline for discussion. ・ Complete assembly drawing and make the design calculation sheet and assembly drawing consistent. ・ Create assembly drawing.

lessons.content: Creating design calculation sheet and assembly drawing-Free-form discussion on design calculation and assembly drawing (part 1): ・ Free-form discussions on the features and ingenuity of each design and assembly drawing among groups with the same design specifications. ・Conduct problem discovery and examination of solutions through group discussions with other students. ・Summarize the results of the study in a report. Listen to problem-solving methods from local engineers to understand design and drafting techniques and deepen discussions.
lessons.operation: Questions and exercises (interim review): Active learning on design calculation and assembly drawings based on design policy Exercise: pp. 75-84
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Prepare for free-form discussions, create design calculation sheets and assembly drawings, and review printed materials. Review: ・ Summarize the knowledge gained from the free-form discussion in a report, and transfer the calculation and drawing corrections to the assembly drawing.

lessons.content: Submission of design calculation sheet, assembly drawing, and report: ・ Submit design calculation sheets and assembly drawings. ・ Submit a report that summarizes the knowledge gained from the free-form discussion and the corrections based on it. Manufacturing method of machine parts and required accuracy: ・ Explain the outline of the manufacturing method of machine parts, and explain each manufacturing method and the processing accuracy required for it. Create part drawings: ・ Start creating parts drawings.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A Exercise Detailed design instructions based on assembly drawings Design: pp. 56-72 Design method: pp. 1-18
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Summarize the knowledge gained from the free-form discussion in a report, complete the design calculations and assembly drawings, and prepare them for submission. ・ Investigate the accuracy of machining and organize the relationship with requirements. Review: ・ Confirm design elements of each component and organize design items. ・ Start creating parts drawings.

lessons.content: Precautions for creating parts drawings: ・ Review the errors that are likely to occur in a parts drawing. In particular, the relationship between geometrical tolerances and dimensional tolerances will be explained again in depth. Create a parts drawing.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A Exercise Explanation of consistency when each component is assembled Design method: pp. 36-59
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Review geometric tolerances and dimensional tolerances, and organize the relationships between them. ・ In particular, investigate the relationship between rotating shafts, bearings, and seals. ・ Create parts drawings. Review: ・ Understand the drafting methods for each tolerance specification in a machine drawing. ・ Create parts drawings.

lessons.content: Return and explanation of design calculation sheet and assembly drawing: ・ Review the assembly drawing and understand any errors to deepen your understanding. Reconfirm drafting rules: ・ Recheck the drafting rules, such as dimensional tolerances, surface roughness, geometric tolerances, and thread representation. Review and correct design calculations and assembly drawings, and transfer these corrections to parts drawings.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A Exercise Reconfirmation of element function and performance and drafting rules for each part and explanation of points during application
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Review the lessons learned in mechanical drawing and machine element design. ・ Create parts drawings. Review: ・ Implement design revisions based on the strength calculation for each part and determine the applicable specifications for parts. ・ Make various revisions of design calculations and assembly drawings, and make them reflect the creation of parts drawings.

lessons.content: Description of parts diagram checklist: ・ Review the content of the parts drawing checklist and deepen your recognition of points to be noted. Exercise for final design solution.
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q&A Exercise Explanation of review exercise of design exercise (design work) following the outline of the detailed design (part diagram) Exercise: pp. 65-74
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Complete strength calculations and the interface design for each part. ・ Recheck the design calculations. Review: ・ Review the design using checkpoints. ・ Complete the design calculation and drawing creation.

lessons.content: Executing design calculations, assembly drawings, and parts drawings-Free discussion on assembly drawings and parts drawings (part 2): ・ Free-form discussion on the features and ingenuity of each design, assembly, and part drawing among groups with the same design specifications, and conduct problem discovery and examination of solutions with other students. ・Summarize the results of the study in a report. Discuss design solutions and design drawings with local engineers and update your design solutions accordingly.
lessons.operation: Questions and exercises Active learning on design solutions
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Outline the final design solution for participation in the free-form discussion and prepare printed materials. Review: ・ Summarize the knowledge and corrections obtained in the free-form discussion, create a report, and incorporate all corrections into the the design calculation sheet, assembly drawing, and parts drawings to complete the final design solution.

lessons.content: Final confirmation and submission of final design solution and report: ・ Final confirmation of the final design solution is performed, and it is confirmed again whether there are any problems in productivity and functionality. ・ Submit the final design solution. Note that if even one of the specified items is insufficient, it will not be evaluated as the final design solution. ・ Submit a report that summarizes the findings and items corrected after the free-form discussion. Implementation of results (practical test): ・ Practical tests will be conducted to measure your mastery of mechanical design, drafting, and CAD operations acquired so far.
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Prepare the final design solution. ・ Prepare for results announcement (practical test).

lessons.content: Explanation and review of results announcement (practical test): ・ Confirmation and review of CAD drafting skills ・ Review of basic items related to design and drafting Performance confirmation test: ・A written test will be given to measure and confirm your level of achievement so far.
lessons.assignments: Preparation: ・ Prepare for the final achievement test

lessons.content: Explanation and review of achievement confirmation test. Self-check: ・ Review topics having insufficient understanding, as indicated by the results of the achievement confirmation test; deepen your understanding. ・ Organize knowledge and ideas obtained from local engineers into a report.
lessons.assignments: Review: ・ Understand the issues of the results announcement (practical exam) and achievement confirmation test, and confirm the achievement goal of this course. ・ Recognize your knowledge and abilities, including knowledge gaps, and restudy course materials as necessary. ・ Note that retests and resubmissions are not allowed.
